caption: The drawing shows a single brown object with a star-like shape viewed from above, featuring multiple pointed edges and an angular, fluted pattern around its perimeter. The object displays irregular yellow, brown, and red hues across its surface, suggesting variations in material or lighting. Positioned within a plain rectangular border in the center of the page, the drawing is complemented by a smaller inset in the upper right corner, which depicts a side profile or elevation view of the same object. This profile view reveals that the object is a relatively shallow, round form, raised on a narrow, round stem and a flat base, resembling a mold or decorative stand. The background of the drawing is a light tan color, and both the main illustration and the inset are framed by thin, straight lines. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the main composition.
title: Curtain Tie Back
